name: Line chart
summary: One or two values over time as lines on a light grid, with the highest and lowest marked and a button that shows the same numbers as a table.
use: for a trend over time, such as a price, a usage figure or a measurement week by week
a11y: The drawing is hidden from screen readers; a data table with row and column headers carries every value and is always readable, and the button shows it on screen.

use_when: an answer about how one or two numbers changed over 2 to 24 periods
avoid_when: amounts per period to compare side by side, or against a budget: use bar-chart
a share of a whole: use donut-breakdown
one current number with no history: use kpi-strip

parts.name: summary
parts.what: the period covered and how to read it

parts.name: unit
parts.what: the unit of the values, above the plot

parts.name: toggle
parts.what: shows the numbers as a table instead of the chart, and back

parts.name: legend
parts.what: which line is which, drawn from the table's headers when there are two

parts.name: plot
parts.what: the lines, the grid and the highest and lowest labels, drawn from the table

parts.name: x_label
parts.what: the name of the time column, such as Week or Month

parts.name: series
parts.what: the name of the first line

parts.name: series2
parts.what: the name of the second line, when there is one

parts.name: points
parts.what: one period: its label and one or two values; a null value is a gap in the line, never a zero

empty.how: with no values the plot shows a quiet line saying there is nothing to show yet

loading.how: show the card with a flat muted band where the plot goes

error.how: if the series fails to load, show error-retry in place of the plot

disabled.how: the chart has one control, the table toggle, which is never disabled

overflow.how: up to 24 points fit any width because the drawing scales; only the first, middle and last labels show under it
overflow.evidence: x labels: first, middle and last, so they never crowd

long_text.how: the title, summary, unit and legend wrap; the table scrolls sideways in its own box

keyboard: Enter or Space shows the table in place of the chart; again brings the chart back
